description.ja: Figure-riseLABO第二弾の研究テーマは「グラデーションによる色彩の表現」！電子の歌姫「初音ミクV4X」が繊細なグラデーションを再現した髪の毛と肌の赤み、透明感のある瞳で登場！
description.en: The second research theme of Figure-riseLABO is "expression of color through gradation "! Electronic diva " Hatsune Miku V4X" appears with delicate gradations in her hair, red skin, and transparent eyes!

description.ja: • 髪表面の半透明素材の厚みを滑らかに変化させることで内部成形色の透け具合をコントロール。成形色のみで髪の美しいグラデーションを表現。
description.en: • By smoothly changing the thickness of the translucent material on the hair surface, you can control the transparency of the internal molding color. Express the beautiful gradation of hair using only molded colors.

description.ja: • フェイスパーツにはFigure-riseLABOで培われたレイヤードインジェクションによるチークの表現を継承。
description.en: • Face parts inherit the cheek expression developed by Figure-riseLABO using layered injection.

description.ja: • 腕と足には偏光パール素材を採用。見る角度によって表情を変える鮮やかな色が、生地の透け感を表現。
description.en: • Polarized pearl material is used for the arms and legs. The vivid colors that change their appearance depending on the viewing angle express the sheerness of the fabric.

description.ja: • 袖口やスカートの裾から見えるフリルはパーツ分割で再現し、浮遊感を演出。
description.en: • The frills visible from the cuffs and the hem of the skirt are reproduced by dividing them into parts, creating a floating feeling.

description.ja: • 肩や腕のマーク、スカートの装飾などディテールを追求。細かなマーキングは付属のドライデカールで再現。
description.en: • Details such as marks on the shoulders and arms, decorations on the skirt, etc. are pursued. Detailed markings are reproduced with the included dry decals.
